name: Moroznyj Poceluj
source:
Dedicated to all fans of "Everlasting Summer".
Everyone celebrates holidays, and Semyon is one of them. We present you a short Christmas story, in which you can spend a little bit more time with former pioneers.
translation: 献给所有《永恒之夏》粉丝。大家都在庆祝节日，谢苗也不例外。这是一则短篇圣诞故事，让你与昔日先锋们多共度一点时光。
